# YanChen Tech Art

> > Portfolio and technical blog of Yan Chen, a technical artist specializing in Unreal Engine 5, Niagara VFX systems, and real-time rendering for games and interactive experiences.

This site showcases professional work spanning game development, virtual production, and interactive installations, with projects for Intel, rhythm games, and short films. The blog provides in-depth tutorials on UE5 features, Niagara particle systems, and technical art workflows.

## Key Topics

- Unreal Engine 5 (UE5)
- Niagara Particle System
- Technical Art
- VFX Artist
- Game Development
- Unreal Engine 4 (UE4)
- Real-time Rendering
- Virtual Production
- Blueprint Visual Scripting
- Lighting Artist
- Interactive Installations
- Character Rigging
- Maya Pipeline
- Mega Lights (UE5.5)
- Rhythm Game Development
